code_version.note: source version unknown; the run records the BigDFT build used

xc_per_element_exceptions.note: no LDA NLCC pseudopotential for Mg in this mapping; Mg claims are not planned

basis_or_grid.bigdft_value: hgrids from the template convergence ladder; rmult [6, 8]
basis_or_grid.note: grid not stated; hgrids scanned by preset; rmult [6,8] chosen (a 2026-10-05 IMLab test showed [5,8]->[6,8] moves the Al13^-1 gap by 2.9 meV and [6,8]->[7,9] by 0.65 meV)

pseudopotentials_or_projectors.note: paper cites the GTH/Willand-2013 NLCC family; exact files unknown. SS (Saha 2015) NLCC files are used. Absolute energies are not comparable (a test run gave -63.31 Ha vs stored -26.67 Ha for Al13^-1); energy differences, gaps and degeneracies are expected to transfer

spin_treatment.bigdft_value: odd electrons: nspin 2, mpol 1; even: nspin 1
spin_treatment.note: the paper does not state the moment for odd counts; the minimal moment is used

charge_states.bigdft_value: dft.qcharge = structure charge + recipe charge offset

smearing_or_electronic_temperature.note: matches the paper for every element offered (Mg not offered)

scf_convergence.note: not stated; a typical BigDFT production value

geometry_relaxation_criterion.note: no prototype claim relaxes a geometry

dispersion_correction.note: not mentioned in the paper; none applied

structure_source.bigdft_value: canonical structures from the registry, verified against the agent's data by hash
